mentions.name: Homebuilt fly-by-wire airplane
mentions.description: A homebuilt airplane 15+ years in the making, currently documenting the architecture and safety concept for its fly-by-wire system. Aerodynamics have held up since outer-mold-line lock about a year ago, with a subscale flight targeted for 2026; remaining full-scale design work covers structures and propulsion integration.
mentions.source_excerpt: Finally writing up the documentation (architecture and safety concept) for the fly-by-wire system for the homebuilt airplane I'm 15+ years into designing.
